## Combo 248-372-1916
Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Changeling Berserker + Changeling Titan
Color identity: RGW | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 8 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Berserker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
  When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
  When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.

  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

## Combo 1916-1938-4846
Cards: Worldgorger Dragon + Changeling Titan + Glorious Protector
Color identity: RGW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 2 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Glorious Protector (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Glorious Protector must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Produces: Infinite mill; Infinite self-mill; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Darien, King of Kjeldor (battlefield); Havoc Jester (battlefield); Altar of Dementia (battlefield); Overgrowth Elemental (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
  When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
  Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
  Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
  Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
  Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
  Repeat.
